title: Critical tribes coalitional influence bound
statement: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $w$, for every natural number $k$ and every coalition $J$ of coordinates of the critical tribes function, if $|J|\le k$, then its influence toward the value $1$ is at most $2k\log d/d$, where $d$ is the dimension of that critical tribes function.
hypotheses_covered: a coalition $J$ in the critical tribes dimension
